activity_summary: You looked at the board after supper. The heel of the loaf was still there, and the cups, and the cloth folded empty. The evening light was in the open door. No one was in the frame.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked, and left the board as it was.

entities.name: the loaf
entities.context: Mentioned in The heel of the loaf

facets.activity: Looked at the board after supper
